# BugFix PR (closes #ticket)

## Brief Bug Description (Required)
Here the dev needs to briefly describe what was the reported bug.

--- 

## What Changed (Required)
Here the dev needs to describe what has been changed and why, preferably with numbered list

--- 

## Tested (Required)
Here the dev needs to describe what has been tested and (mostly) work.

--- 

## Not Tested (Required)
Here the dev needs to describe what has NOT been tested or needs further testing.
